scope: CVG-002 bounded database authority for one non-closed encounter per tenant patient

criteria.description: The clinical integrity gap, bounded scope, owner, authority and exclusions are recorded without promoting CVG-002 or the global ERP gate.
criteria.limitations: Only repository-local code, one additive migration and disposable PostgreSQL verification are authorized; historical duplicate remediation and target behavior remain open.

criteria.description: The current encounter service performs only a process-local duplicate check and the canonical database insert lacks an active patient uniqueness invariant; the repository and migration are the smallest authoritative hardening boundary.
criteria.limitations: A migration preflight must refuse unresolved historical duplicates; no existing data is authorized for automatic normalization.

criteria.description: Focused RED tests can prove the missing cross-runtime invariant, then GREEN tests can prove one winner, stable conflict mapping, tenant separation and close/reopen lifecycle behavior.
criteria.limitations: Implementation, fresh PostgreSQL race evidence, security/static review and post-change regressions are required before bounded verification.

gaps: The additive migration, unique-violation translation, RED/GREEN tests and fresh concurrent PostgreSQL evidence are not complete at gate creation.
conditions: Do not apply the migration to a database with unresolved active duplicates; the preflight must fail closed.

authority.actor: Ricardo (repository owner), via the original consolidation brief
authority.scope: CVG-002 bounded active-encounter uniqueness and conflict mapping
authority.decision: Authorize reversible repository implementation, one additive canonical packages/db migration, focused API/domain tests and disposable PostgreSQL concurrency verification for the invariant that a tenant patient has at most one non-closed encounter. Exclude historical duplicate remediation, provider, credentials, target, production, deployment, external mutation and release acceptance.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before normalizing historical duplicates, changing encounter lifecycle semantics beyond this invariant, target operations, production/deployment or release acceptance.

next_action: Write and run the intentional repository/service RED tests, then implement the additive index and named unique-violation mapping.
